title: incus-spawn mcp.yaml
description: What isx mcp lets a local agent do, ~/.config/incus-spawn/mcp.yaml. Only a person edits it. A key isx does not know makes the whole file invalid, so no mistyped restriction is dropped in silence.

templates.description: The only templates an agent may branch from. A missing list approves none.

max-instances.description: Instances per host user, across sessions, counting creates in flight.

max-concurrent-tasks.description: Background commands and delegated agents, per host user, across sessions.

orphan-grace-hours.description: How long an instance outlives the session that held it.

dormant-after-hours.description: How long an orphan kept only for a task that shows no activity waits before it is stopped, not destroyed.

dormant-grace-hours.description: How long after it was stopped such an instance is destroyed.

summary-model.description: The Claude Code model, or alias, that answers a tool's ask inside the instance.

host-tools.description: MCP tools that run a command you wrote on the host. The agent cannot change the command.

command.description: Run through bash -c. A tilde expands.

description.description: What the model is told the tool does.

timeout.description: Seconds the command may run. 0 is no limit.

min-interval.description: Seconds between invocations. 0 is no limit.

delegate-max-turns.description: Retired: has no effect, and may be deleted.

delegate-permission-mode.description: Retired: has no effect, and may be deleted.

delegate-permission-modes.description: Retired: has no effect, and may be deleted.

codex.description: Retired: has no effect while it holds only sandbox-mode or sandbox-modes, and may be deleted.
